Notes: The hub's own Ofab vending machines (playfield 6007, template ids in OfabHubStock.json) sell the armor and weapons. This script is unused unless a content NPC still carries ddogs-ofab-vp.

hello.Text: Unicorn Defense Hub. Ofab armor and weapons are paid in Victory Points, not credits. The window shows 0 credits on purpose. Use opens the stock.

price.Text: House price: QL times QL, divided by 40. QL 1 is 1 VP. QL 100 is 250. QL 200 is 1000. QL 300 is 2250. Team alien ships, invasions, and city raids pay Victory Points.
